ideas.pitch: A lightweight telemetry dashboard using an ESP32 strapped to the RC car to stream live motor temperature, battery voltage, and speed via Wi-Fi during the racing phase.
ideas.title: PitStop Telemetry: Real-Time RC Car Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since winners are judged by combined total time, having an edge on vehicle health and preventing thermal throttling or battery dropouts directly addresses the core racing phase metric.

ideas.pitch: A rapid-prototyping workflow to design, simulate, and 3D print a custom aerodynamic wing and chassis shroud specifically tailored to improve handling on the competition track's tightest turns.
ideas.title: AeroTune: CFD & 3D Printed Downforce Kit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Most teams will focus purely on raw assembly speed; adding mechanical engineering customization for handling targets the second half of the scoring metric (Racing Time).

ideas.pitch: An edge-computer vision setup using an affordable camera module and OpenCV to automatically track and time RC car laps as they cross the finish line, eliminating human stopwatch error.
ideas.title: SpeedSnap: Automated Lap Timing & Gate Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immense utility to the event organizers and judges during practice rounds, making the team stand out through infrastructure contribution.

ideas.pitch: An ergonomic, wearable glove embedded with an IMU sensor to steer the RC car via hand tilts instead of the standard plastic controller, giving superior tactile precision.
ideas.title: SteerCraft: Custom Gesture-Controlled Transmitting Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines unusual physical hardware building with a live demonstration that instantly grabs judges' attention during the racing heats.

ideas.pitch: An inline current-sensing module wired between the battery and motor that logs peak draw to help teams optimize their gear ratios and prevent burnout during high-stress final races.
ideas.title: TorqueGuard: Smart Gear Ratio & Current Limiter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles mechanical reliability under pressure, ensuring the car survives the initial heats into the semi-finals and finals without catastrophic electrical failure.
